datasets.description: Malawi Medium Term Projection FEWS NET Acute Food Insecurity Classifications Geographic data for 2021. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/malawi_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2021]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2021, classifying geographic areas in Malawi into food insecurity phases based on standardized IPC methodology. The spatial data was compiled into monthly GeoJSON and KML files representing medium-term projections of acute food insecurity conditions.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys, providing monthly projections of acute food insecurity phases across administrative divisions in Malawi.
